masterGain._comment: Unmuted master gain; scales all audio buses.

musicGain._comment: Normal music bus gain, including recovery after thunder.

effectsGain._comment: Recorded animals and event sound bus gain.

smoothingSeconds._comment: Gain target time constant for activation, mute and pause.

startLeadSeconds._comment: Initial look-ahead before the first music step.

intervalMs._comment: Music scheduling timer interval in milliseconds.

lookAheadSeconds._comment: How far ahead each music scheduling callback queues notes.

maxStepsPerTick._comment: Hard work budget per scheduler callback; missed beats are skipped.

clearDelaySeconds._comment: Minimum delay between clear-weather bird calls.

rainDelaySeconds._comment: Minimum delay between rainy-weather bird calls.

frameCapSeconds._comment: Maximum elapsed bird clock step; avoids return-from-background bursts.

rainSuppressionIntensity._comment: Rain intensity at which bird calls stop; storms always suppress calls.

clearGain._comment: Per-call bird gain in clear or windy weather.

rainGain._comment: Per-call bird gain in light rain.

frameCapSeconds._comment: Maximum livestock clock step on one update.

alertThreshold._comment: Alert above this level uses the herded call cadence.

initialDelaySeconds._comment: Minimum initial call delay before species scaling.

initialJitterSeconds._comment: Seeded initial delay spread before species scaling.

calmDelaySeconds._comment: Minimum calm or wandering call interval before species scaling.

calmJitterSeconds._comment: Seeded spread of calm call intervals.

herdedDelaySeconds._comment: Minimum herded call interval; a new bolt still calls immediately.

herdedJitterSeconds._comment: Seeded spread of herded call intervals.

sheepIntervalScale._comment: Multiplier applied only to sheep call intervals.

maxStartsPerFrame._comment: Ordinary call starts allowed per simulation update.

maxVoices._comment: Maximum overlapping livestock calls; a new bolt replaces the oldest.

maxDistance._comment: Listener distance beyond which calls are skipped, in world units.

attenuationDistance._comment: World distance at which call gain halves.

gain._comment: Baseline per-call livestock gain before state and distance scaling.

herdedGainScale._comment: Gain multiplier while herded or bolting.

cowPitchBase._comment: Lowest identity playback rate for cows before per-call variation.

cowPitchSpread._comment: Seeded identity playback-rate spread for cows.

cowPitchVariation._comment: Peak-to-peak cow playback-rate variation between calls.

sheepPitchBase._comment: Lowest identity playback rate for sheep before per-call variation.

sheepPitchSpread._comment: Seeded identity playback-rate spread for sheep.

sheepPitchVariation._comment: Peak-to-peak sheep playback-rate variation between calls.

durationBaseScale._comment: Base livestock duration multiplier before seeded variation.

loadTimeoutMs._comment: Timeout for each recorded animal asset request.

startLeadSeconds._comment: Lead time before a recorded or fallback animal source starts.

barkDurationSeconds._comment: Synthesized bark duration and missing-buffer duration fallback.

cowDurationSeconds._comment: Synthesized cow duration and missing-buffer duration fallback.

sheepDurationSeconds._comment: Synthesized sheep duration and missing-buffer duration fallback.

livestockFadeFraction._comment: Maximum fraction of a livestock call used by its tail fade.

livestockAttackFraction._comment: Maximum fraction of a livestock call used by its onset fade.

stopPaddingSeconds._comment: Buffer-source stop padding after its audible envelope.

defaultIntensity._comment: Intensity for a weather name without a structured state.

rainGain._comment: Rain noise gain before tier and intensity scaling.

windGain._comment: Wind noise gain before intensity scaling.

rainLowpassHz._comment: Rain noise low-pass cutoff in hertz.

windLowpassHz._comment: Wind noise low-pass cutoff in hertz.

gainChangeThreshold._comment: Minimum weather gain change before scheduling a target.

smoothingSeconds._comment: Time constant for weather gain changes.

eventToleranceSeconds._comment: Grace period after the paired thunder delay; older events are observed silently.

startLeadSeconds._comment: Minimum lead before a thunder source begins.

duckSeconds._comment: Time constant when ducking music for thunder.

recoveryFraction._comment: Fraction of thunder duration before music recovers.

recoverySeconds._comment: Music recovery time constant after thunder.

maxVoices._comment: Shared active-source ceiling for synthesized event notes.

pipPitch._comment: Pip bark playback rate; Buddy keeps the source rate.
